mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness that reduces corporate earnings visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 signals a supply-side economic slowdown that increases recession risk and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained CPI reading above 220.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening expectations, reducing equity risk appetite and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 220.0.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 600,000 units indicates weak residential construction activity that signals broader economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 600.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly employment decline exceeding 100,000 jobs (PAYEMS < 130000) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 130000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 220.0) indicate stagflation risk that erodes corporate margins and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and CPIAUCSL > 220.0.
